title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: Rust lichen-link shared_vectors.rs missing 'crypto' field — compile error
description:
**Severity: CRITICAL — Build failure**

`rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs:89` accesses `vector.crypto` but the `LinkFrameVector` struct (lines 19-26) has no `crypto` field. This causes a compilation error when the `schnorr` feature is enabled:

```
error[E0609]: no field `crypto` on type `&LinkFrameVector`
  --> lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs:89:39
```

**Fix:** Add a `crypto: Option<CryptoEntry>` field (or similar) to `LinkFrameVector` with `#[serde(default)]`, or remove the dead `#[cfg(feature = "schnorr")]` block.
